SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Connect your stores so agents see a customer's orders next to the conversation. Read-only: Lynomia never changes anything in your store.

FORM.TITLE: Add a WooCommerce store
FORM.NAME: Display name (optional)
FORM.READ_ONLY_HINT: In WooCommerce go to Settings → Advanced → REST API, add a key with Read permission for an administrator, and paste it here.
FORM.KEYS_HINT: Keys are encrypted and never shown again.

PICKER.TITLE: Add a store
PICKER.DESCRIPTION: Choose the platform your store runs on.
PICKER.WOOCOMMERCE_HINT: Connect with a read-only REST API key.
PICKER.SALLA_HINT: Install the Lynomia app from the Salla App Store. No keys to copy.
PICKER.ZID_HINT: Authorize the Lynomia app on Zid. No keys to copy.

SALLA.TITLE: Connect with Salla
SALLA.DESCRIPTION: Lynomia only reads customers, orders and shipments. You never enter or see a Salla token here.
SALLA.STEP_INSTALL: Install the Lynomia app in Salla.
SALLA.STEP_SETTINGS: In your Salla dashboard, open the Lynomia app's settings, paste the code and save.

STATUS.WAITING: Waiting for the code from Salla…
STATUS.CLAIMED: Code received. Waiting for Salla to authorize the app…
STATUS.CONFLICT: This Salla store is connected to another Lynomia account. Disconnect it there first.
STATUS.EXPIRED: This code expired. Create a new one.

SALLA.REAUTH_HINT: Salla needs to authorize the Lynomia app again: update or reinstall it from your Salla dashboard. The store reconnects on its own.
SALLA.PROVIDER_OFF: Salla is turned off on this installation. The store is kept but not read.

ZID.TITLE: Connect with Zid
ZID.DESCRIPTION: Lynomia only reads customers, orders and shipments. You never enter or see a Zid token here.
ZID.STEPS: You will sign in to Zid and approve the Lynomia app for your store, then come back here.
ZID.REAUTH_HINT: Zid needs you to authorize the Lynomia app again. Use Reconnect.
ZID.PROVIDER_OFF: Zid is turned off on this installation. The store is kept but not read.
ZID.DISCONNECT_DESCRIPTION: The store's access, its webhooks and every customer link of this store are deleted. Nothing changes in the store. You can connect it again with Zid.

DISCONNECT_CONFIRM.TITLE: Disconnect {name}?
DISCONNECT_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: The store's credentials and every customer link of this store are deleted. Nothing changes in the store.
DISCONNECT_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION_APP: The store's access and every customer link of this store are deleted. Nothing changes in the store. To connect it again, reinstall the Lynomia app in Salla and enter a new code.
